title: pasania hemisphaerica
intro: Pasania hemisphaerica, commonly known as the Yellow Elm, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Pasania hemisphaerica include its ability to act as an antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
